reportIntro: The details are filled in. Add a few words on what you were doing; you see all of it before it goes out.
title: Send feedback to the makers of Kobble
intro: A wish or something wrong, in a few words. It goes on the public feedback board on GitHub, where the makers answer. Your code and your product stay private.
what: What you were doing, and what you expected
whatWish: What you wanted to do, and why
withErrors: Errors the factory caught, to send with it
checkTitle: This is all that goes out
checkIntro: Word for word, as it will be on the public board ({{board}}). Change anything, or remove a part.
teamData: Errors can carry your team's data: names, repositories, card titles. The board is public, so change or remove what should stay with you.
nothingElse: Nothing else is sent: no files, no code, no data from your product.
signInFirst: Sent with your own GitHub account.
thanks: Thank you, it is on the board
onBoard: The makers read it there; other teams can add a 👍.
follow: You see here how it stands: seen when the makers have read it, planned when they will do it, done when it is in a new Kobble.

stateHelp.sent: On the board, not read yet
stateHelp.done: It is in a new Kobble

personaUnsure: Sprocket isn't sure who this is.
similarHelp: If one is yours, add a 👍 instead of a new one.

chat.placeholder: I wish I could…, or: it stops when…
chat.hint: A wish, or something wrong? Just tell me in your own words: I write it up for the makers of Kobble.
chat.invite: Tell me in your own words: something you wish Kobble did, or something that went wrong. I write it up for its makers, on their public board.
chat.askWish: Good one. What would you do with it? A moment from your work helps the makers most.
chat.askBug: Sorry about that. What were you doing when it happened, and what did you expect?
chat.askError:
The factory hit this error:

`{{error}}`

What were you doing when it happened?
chat.similar: {{teams}} teams want this too. Add your 👍 instead of a new post?
chat.similarBug: {{teams}} teams ran into this too. Add your 👍 instead of a new post?
chat.thumbed: Your 👍 is on #{{n}}. I tell you here when it moves.
chat.draft: Here is what I would send. Change anything, or tell me what to add.
chat.draftTeam: I marked what looks like your team's data (names, repositories, card titles). The board is public: click a mark to take it out.
chat.posted: Sent as #{{n}} on the public board. I follow it here: seen, planned, done.

moved.planned: #{{n}} is planned: the makers will do it.
moved.done: #{{n}} is done: it is in a new Kobble.
